Blades 0.42 embeds FFmpeg 2.8.22, Copyright (c) the FFmpeg developers.
FFmpeg is free software under the GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1
or, at your option, any later version. See FFMPEG-LGPL-2.1.txt.
Build configuration disables GPL and nonfree components.
Blades application code is MIT; fonts/artwork retain their separate notices.

Complete corresponding application/FFmpeg source, local changes, build scripts
and a pinned open-source SDK are available in:
https://github.com/sbayfield09/Blades/raw/refs/heads/main/dist/Blades-v0.42-source.zip
The immutable matching link is also in the release download instructions.
See BUILDING.txt within that archive to replace FFmpeg and rebuild/relink the
executable using the free xsdk GCC toolchain. Reverse engineering/debugging for
modifications to the LGPL library is permitted. No warranty is provided.
No GPL Simple360Player application/UI code or XDK player binary is linked.
